name: Campingplatz Alpenwelt Tannheimer Tal
beschreibung: The Campingplatz Alpenwelt Tannheimer Tal is located in the municipality of Tannheim in the Tannheimer Tal of the same name. The location is characterized by the surrounding mountain landscape of the Allgäuer Alpen. The region has marked hiking trails and cycling paths for various difficulty levels. In winter, the ski areas of the Tannheimer Tal as well as adjacent areas in Deutschland are accessible. The campsite's facilities include pitches for motorhomes, caravans, and tents with corresponding sanitary infrastructure. The campsite serves as a starting point for active vacations and excursions into the alpine surroundings.
